prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1148
Claimant:
Jennifer Tyler
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
15 Jun 2023
The claim was reported by the insured's representing attorney after a low-speed head-on collision, and the adjuster
opened a file and requested the police report and initial photographs.
15 Jul 2023
The police report confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision, and the driver is named on the
policy in force on the loss date.
22 Sep 2023
Scene photographs show the front-end damage and confirm several details of the impact, but no independent
witnesses have come forward to describe how the collision happened.
1 Oct 2023
Reviewing the vehicle file, no prior damage to the vehicle is known, and nothing in the records suggests the damage
occurred before the coverage period began.
2 Oct 2023
The claimant reports neck and back strain and has described the same account in every conversation so far, with the
injury pattern appearing consistent with the kind and force of this crash.
3 Nov 2023
The claimant's medical records show no earlier injury to the same body area, and the treatment so far has followed a
usual course that has tapered off as the claimant improved.
24 Nov 2023
Repair estimates have been reviewed, but it is not yet clear whether all of the listed damage came from this impact,
so the appraiser has been asked to isnpect the vehicle again.
3 Dec 2023
Counsel for the claimant confirmed by letter that the claimant will provide the treatment records and wage information
requested in the earlier correspondence.
6 Dec 2023
The adjuster spoke with the treating provider's office, which confirmed the visit dates and the course of care, and
noted that the claimant's account of symptoms has stayed consistent across each visit.
13 Dec 2023
Pending receipt of the appraiser's supplemental report, the adjuster is reviewing whether the damage listing needs to
be separated by cause before any settlement offer is made.
3 Feb 2024
The file remains open while the supplemental appraisal and outstanding records are collected, and the adjuster will
update the reserve once those items are received.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
